chengdu-to-chongqing.name: Chengdu ↔ Chongqing
chengdu-to-chongqing.approx_cost: High-speed G train Chengdu East → Chongqing West about 1 h 15 min, 2nd class CN¥129 (sampled fare); G trains to Chongqing North about 1.5 h, CN¥161–175; D trains about 1 h 55 min from CN¥96. Fares are dynamic; ~160 trains a day; some stop at Shapingba.

chongqing-ciqikou.name: Ciqikou Ancient Town
chongqing-ciqikou.approx_cost: Free; small fees for some sites (e.g. Zhong family courtyard about CN¥10–20)
chongqing-ciqikou.hours: Streets open all day; shops and restaurants close about 21:00-22:00
chongqing-ciqikou.address_local: 重庆市沙坪坝区磁器口街道 400000

chongqing-dazu-rock-carvings.name: Dazu Rock Carvings (Baodingshan)
chongqing-dazu-rock-carvings.approx_cost: Baodingshan CN¥115 (peak), CN¥100–110 off-season; Beishan CN¥70; Baodingshan + Beishan combo about CN¥140
chongqing-dazu-rock-carvings.hours: 8:30-17:30 (Chongqing government page); another guide 9:00-18:00, last admission 16:30

closed.partial: Baodingshan museum only (open on public holidays); the carvings stay open

chongqing-dazu-rock-carvings.address_local: 重庆市大足区宝顶镇双山镇合内路

chongqing-eling-park.name: Eling Park and Eling Second Factory
chongqing-eling-park.approx_cost: Park free; Kansheng Tower small fee (CN¥5 or CN¥20, sources disagree); Second Factory free, venues charge separately
chongqing-eling-park.hours: Park about 6:00-22:00 (another source 8:00-22:30); Eling Second Factory open all day
chongqing-eling-park.best_season: spring and autumn; clear days for views
chongqing-eling-park.name_local: 鹅岭公园 / 鹅岭二厂
chongqing-eling-park.address_local: 重庆市渝中区两路口街道

chongqing-hongyadong.name: Hongyadong
chongqing-hongyadong.hours: Complex open 24 h; shops and restaurants about 10:00-22:00; lights from dusk to about 23:00 (sources vary)
chongqing-hongyadong.best_season: spring and autumn; avoid national holidays
chongqing-hongyadong.address_local: 重庆市两江新区渝中区朝天门街道江北千厮门大桥 400013

chongqing-jiefangbei.name: Jiefangbei (People's Liberation Monument)
chongqing-jiefangbei.address_local: 重庆市渝中区解放碑街道 400010

chongqing-liziba-station.name: Liziba Station (monorail through a building)
chongqing-liziba-station.approx_cost: Free viewing platform; riding costs a normal metro fare
chongqing-liziba-station.address_local: 重庆市渝中区上清寺街道李子坝正街 400015

chongqing-three-gorges-museum.name: Chongqing China Three Gorges Museum
chongqing-three-gorges-museum.address_local: 重庆市渝中区上清寺街道人民路236 400015

chongqing-to-shanghai.name: Chongqing ↔ Shanghai
chongqing-to-shanghai.approx_cost: Non-stop about 2.5 h; economy fares quoted from about CN¥200 to CN¥1,870 depending on date.

chongqing-to-shanghai-train.name: Chongqing ↔ Shanghai
chongqing-to-shanghai-train.approx_cost: High-speed rail about 9–14 h (2026 G-train example 12 h 23 min); 2nd class about CN¥840–953 in 2026 guides (dynamic fares).

chongqing-wulong-three-natural-bridges.name: Wulong Karst – Three Natural Bridges
chongqing-wulong-three-natural-bridges.approx_cost: CN¥125 incl. shuttle bus and elevator (Dec 2025 ticket site); concessions CN¥105/CN¥85; another guide quotes CN¥150
chongqing-wulong-three-natural-bridges.address_local: 重庆市武隆区仙女山街道银杏大道

chongqing-yangtze-river-cableway.name: Yangtze River Cableway
chongqing-yangtze-river-cableway.approx_cost: CN¥30 one way, CN¥50 return (April 2026 local guide); combo one way + 'Eye of the Clouds' observation deck CN¥98. English guides still quote CN¥20 / CN¥30
chongqing-yangtze-river-cableway.hours: About 7:30-22:30 (Mar–Oct) and 8:00-21:00 (Nov–Feb); other listings give 8:00-22:00, last entry 21:00
chongqing-yangtze-river-cableway.best_season: all year; long queues on holidays
chongqing-yangtze-river-cableway.address_local: 重庆市渝中区朝天门街道响水桥社区长江滨江路 400010
